problem: The mean weight of a group of ballet dancers is $45\text{ kg}.$ One of the dancers in the ballet group weighs $38\text{ kg}$, and her $z$-score is $-2.5.$ Find the standard deviation of the weight of the dancers in the ballet group.

feedback.problem:
The mean heart rate of a group of patients during light exercise is $\overset{¯}{x}=70$ beats per minute. A particular patient in this group has a heart rate of $74$ beats per minute, and his $z$-score is $z=2.5.$ Find the standard deviation of the patients' heart rates in the group.

The standard deviation of the heart rates is
{{field-1}}
beats per minute.
feedback.worked_solution:
To compute the value of an observation $x$ which yields a given $z$-score in a data set with mean $\overset{―}{x}$ and standard deviation $\sigma ,$ we can use the following formula:

$$
x=\overset{―}{x}+z\cdot \sigma 
$$

Substituting $\overset{―}{x}=70,$ $z=2.5,$ and $x=74$ into the formula and solving for $\sigma ,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}x & =\overset{―}{x}+z\cdot \sigma  \\ 74 & =70+2.5\cdot \sigma  \\ 4 & =2.5\cdot \sigma  \\ \sigma  & =\frac{4}{2.5} \\ \sigma  & =1.6.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the standard deviation of the patients' heart rates in the group is $1.6$ beats per minute.
